_: FROZEN INTENT CONTRACT. Digest pinned in docs/build1/FROZEN_INTENTS.json and enforced by tests/gate_ask_spine_contract_frozen.js. The executor reads this file; it contains no business truth of its own.
question: For the current maintenance obligations associated with work orders in this property, what is the current assignment and acceptance state?

scope.not: work_orders.assigned_to is free text with no governed writer and is NEVER read by this intent. The work order is the related operating context; the obligation is the thing somebody currently has to do.
scope.property: server-derived from the authenticated operator session; never client-supplied

consequence_class_means: no maintenance or obligation domain mutation of any kind. Ask Spine knowing an obligation is unassigned does not give it authority to assign it. A durable read receipt is required audit history, not an operational consequence.

candidate_predicate.principle: one complete population of current maintenance obligations that relate to a work order, in this property. No recent-N sample, no exclusion for tidiness.
candidate_predicate.filter: property_id = <session property> AND related_type = 'work_order' AND module = 'maintenance' AND status IN ('open','in_progress')
candidate_predicate.why_module_filter: a leasing obligation that happens to carry a work-order-shaped reference is not maintenance ownership. Proven: attack_obligation_ownership_rail P5.1.
candidate_predicate.why_status_filter: this is a CURRENT-state question. A completed or cancelled obligation is not something somebody currently has to do.
candidate_predicate.cardinality: MANY obligations per work order. No unique index constrains it (attack_obligation_ownership_rail P3.2), so the answer entity is the OBLIGATION and every record keeps its own type, status, assignee and acceptance. Grouping under a work order is presentation, never aggregation.
candidate_predicate.ordering: deterministic: work_order_ref, then obligation type, then obligation id

ownership_states.derivation: mechanical, from durable fields only. Never inferred from activity, age, notes or model judgement.
ownership_states.assigned_not_accepted: assigned_user_id IS NOT NULL AND accepted_by_user_id IS NULL
ownership_states.assigned_accepted: assigned_user_id IS NOT NULL AND accepted_by_user_id = assigned_user_id
ownership_states.impossible: accepted_by_user_id <> assigned_user_id — refused by ck_oblig_accepter_is_owner; and accepted with no assignee — refused by ck_oblig_acceptance_has_owner (migration 142)
ownership_states.absence_of_acceptance_means_not_accepted: never 'accepted by implication', never 'probably accepted because work started'

required_sources.why: the governing object. Assignment and acceptance are its durable fields.

optional_sources.why: an assignee's CURRENT standing on this property's team is genuinely separable from the assignment fact: a person can be deactivated while obligations still name them. Not manufactured to exercise PARTIAL — the assignment fact stands either way.
optional_sources.degradation: a failed read degrades coverage to PARTIAL. A row whose assignee has no active standing is reported as assigned with standing unavailable. IT NEVER BECOMES UNASSIGNED — that would corrupt the operating fact.

facets.over: the FULL candidate population, never the capped page

evidence_time_rules.principle: read time is not fact time. There is no governed reassignment history, so this intent is a CURRENT-STATE question and may not claim durations or prior owners.
basis_order: latest obligations.accepted_at among the supporting records
latest obligations.updated_at among the supporting records
none — reported honestly as null with a basis of no_evidence_timestamp
evidence_time_rules.forbidden: substituting now() for a missing evidence timestamp; claiming how long an assignment has been held

result_cap_note: This intent has ONE lane, so per-lane and overall are the same rule; the field keeps the executor's single vocabulary rather than inventing a second. Facet counts come from the FULL population and are unaffected by the cap — the whole point of separating them.
withheld_conclusions: how long the current owner has held it
whether an assigned person is eligible under a future authority resolver
whether the work itself is complete
whether the current owner should be changed
withheld_conclusions_note: assignment is not acceptance is not accountability. An assigned user is the current obligation assignee; an accepted_by is that assignee confirming they took it on. Neither is institutional accountability, and the organization/accountability resolver does not exist yet. Do not pre-empt it with loose wording.

renderer_contract.principle: the executor emits a conclusion code and counts; the renderer turns them into operator language. No model output reaches operating truth.
forbidden_in_output: free text authored by a model
any claim not derivable from the fields above
a single owner per work order — the cardinality is many and flattening destroys information
